en.headline: HKU research chief seeks lab space in the Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Anderson Shum, vice-president for research since August, told the South China Morning Post the university town could house new dry and wet laboratories.
body: The University of Hong Kong is looking for more laboratory space in the Northern Metropolis university town, its new research vice-president said.

Professor Anderson Shum Ho-cheung, who took up the post in August, told the South China Morning Post in an interview published on Monday morning that the megaproject offers room the university needs for hardware, including new dry and wet laboratories. He said HKU's research plans would follow the government's line of tying together education, technology, industry and talent as the Northern Metropolis is built out.

Shum also called for more government research funding. Grant applications take time, he said, and returns on that spending can be slow. He described a loop in which laboratory work moves into industry partnerships and start-ups, and problems from those ventures come back to researchers.

The comments follow the administration's first five-year plan and this year's policy address, both of which put the Northern Metropolis among the city's main development projects. The university has not announced a site or a timetable for any new laboratories.

zh.headline: 港大研究副校長尋北都實驗室空間
zh.dek: 八月上任的研究副校長沈浩正向《南華早報》表示，大學城可容納大學需要的新乾濕實驗室。
body: 香港大學新任研究副校長表示，港大正尋求在北部都會區大學城取得更多實驗室空間。
沈浩正教授八月出任該職。他在星期一早上見報的《南華早報》專訪中說，這項大型項目可提供大學需要的硬件空間，包括新的乾實驗室和濕實驗室。他又說，港大的科研發展會配合政府把教育、科技、產業和人才串連起來、加快北部都會區建設的方向。
沈浩正同時呼籲政府增加科研撥款。他說，申請資助需時，投資回報亦可以很慢。他形容一條閉環：實驗室的發現經由產業合作和新創公司變成應用，成功項目再把新問題交回科研人員。
有關言論見於政府首份五年規劃及今年施政報告之後，兩份文件都把北部都會區列為主要發展項目。港大暫未公布任何新實驗室的選址或時間表。
